name: zsnd_update_listener_state
description: zSnd_UpdateListenerState updates cached listener state for the software backend and forwards position, orientation, and velocity to the A3D backend when active.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this listener-state helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zSound/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4a2950 validates backend 0 cached listener-state and velocity copies, listener-state-valid update, backend 1 null-listener error return, A3D SetPosition/SetOrientation/SetVelocity dispatches with negated forward vector, and success return.
The native listener-state smoke verifies software cache updates, backend-1 null-listener failure, and A3D listener position/orientation/velocity dispatches.
